patent-management-system 1.0.0

- Initial release of the 企业专利管理系统构建助手 for synthetic biology/life science companies.
- Enables automated, full-featured patent management system generation using PatSnap APIs, outputting a single-file HTML visualization.
- Includes 8 core modules: Dashboard, Patent Asset Library, Fee Management, Agent Analysis, Competitor Tracking, FTO Analysis, Patent Value Evaluation, and AI Novelty Search.
- Supports one-click patent data sync, real competitive intelligence, fee alerts, value scoring, and risk analysis.
- Designed for easy re-use, with clear module specs, data structure examples, and best-practice “pitfall” guidelines.
- Requires MCP authorization for live data; provides framework and analysis guidance if not configured.
